svg.aria-label: A donation escrow drawn as a bench machine. Coins wait in a vault and ride a rail through three gates, one per milestone, each stamped once its proof is posted. The first gate is open and its coins sit in the organizer's tray; a loaded cart waits at the second while a 72-hour timer runs and donors read photos and a receipt under a loupe; a chute in front of that gate returns coins to a donor tray, for donors who walk away; the third gate is shut.
